paper_title: Indacenodifuran-Based Non-Fullerene Electron Acceptors for Effcient Polymer Solar Cells

knowledge_points.content: The central core of the new non-fullerene acceptors is indaceno[1,2-b:5,6-b']difuran (IDF), which is synthesized from diethyl 2,5-dibromoterephthalate and 2-n-butyltin furan via Stille coupling and cyclization.
knowledge_points.evidence: IDF was synthesized from diethyl 2,5-dibromoterephthalate and 2-n-butyltin furan via Stille coupling and cyclization reactions.

knowledge_points.content: Furan is utilized as a building block for NFAs because it is more electron-rich than thiophene, possesses a large dipole moment that enhances intramolecular charge transfer (ICT), and has a smaller atomic size that promotes stronger π-π molecular stacking.
knowledge_points.evidence: furan is a more electron-rich block than thiophene; the enhanced electron-donating capability will be able to induce a red-shifted absorption... the furan unit also has a large dipole moment, which may generate various dipole interactions with the enhanced intramolecular charge transfer (ICT). In addition, the small size of the furan unit may produce stronger π-π molecular stacking

knowledge_points.content: The PM6:IDF-IC device achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 7.80% with an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.905 V, a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 14.55 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 59%.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PM6/IDF-IC device yielded a promising PCE of 7.80% with Voc of 0.905 V; short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 14.55 mA/cm2 and fill factor (FF) of 59%

knowledge_points.content: The PM6:IDF-4F device achieved a PCE of 7.81% with a Voc of 0.736 V, a Jsc of 17.49 mA/cm², and a fill factor of 61%.
knowledge_points.evidence: whereas the PM6/IDF-4F device gave a PCE of 7.81% with Voc of 0.736 V, Jsc of 17.49 mA/cm2 and FF of 61%.

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of fluorine atoms in the end groups of IDF-4F lowers the LUMO energy level to -4.27 eV compared to -4.13 eV for IDF-IC, leading to a reduced Voc but an increased Jsc in solar cell devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: Their LUMO energy levels are estimated to be -4.13 and -4.27 eV for IDF-IC and IDF-4F, respectively... The higher Jsc in the IDF-4F device should be from the more desirable interpenetrating network between PM6 and IDF-4F as induced by F-F interactions.

knowledge_points.content: Furan-based NFAs exhibit a significant red-shift in absorption compared to their thiophene counterparts (e.g., IDT-IC) due to the stronger electron-donating capability of the furan unit.
knowledge_points.evidence: The absorption band of IDF-IC and IDF-4F gave a significant red-shift compared to that of IDT-IC... This red-shift is mainly due to the strong electron-donating capability of the furan unit in IDF.

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgaps for IDF-IC and IDF-4F in film states are 1.63 eV and 1.56 eV, respectively, corresponding to absorption edges at 760 nm and 795 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The absorption edges of IDF-IC and IDF-4F in films were at 760 and 795 nm, corresponding to the bandgaps of 1.63 and 1.56 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Electrostatic potential (ESP) analysis shows that most parts of IDF-IC and IDF-4F have positive ESP distributions, which directs the intermolecular electric field (IEF) toward the polymer donor, facilitating exciton dissociation.
knowledge_points.evidence: The largely distributed positive ESP will direct the intermolecular electric field (IEF) from IDF-IC (or IDF-4F) to the polymer donor, which is favorable for exciton dissociation and charge extraction.

knowledge_points.content: High-performance devices based on IDF-IC and IDF-4F can be fabricated without the use of solvent additives like 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) or solvent vapor annealing, making them suitable for large-area fabrication.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is noted that these device performances were achieved without any solvent additives or a solvent annealing process, which is desirable for large area fabrication technologies.

knowledge_points.content: IDF-4F blend films show a smoother surface morphology with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 1.37 nm, compared to 3.03 nm for IDF-IC, indicating better miscibility with the PM6 polymer donor.
knowledge_points.evidence: The film of PM6:IDF-4F, however, exhibited a smoother surface morphology with a decreased RMS roughness value of 1.37 nm... whereas small aggregates can be observed in the PM6:IDF-IC film.

knowledge_points.content: Exciton dissociation probabilities (Pdiss) for PM6:IDF-IC and PM6:IDF-4F devices were calculated to be 84.81% and 85.71%, respectively, under short-circuit conditions.
knowledge_points.evidence: The Pdiss values of PM6:IDF-IC and PM6:IDF-4F devices were calculated to be 84.81% and 85.71% respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Thermal annealing at 130 °C significantly improves the device performance of PM6:IDF-IC and PM6:IDF-4F by enhancing the short-circuit current density (Jsc) and fill factor (FF).
knowledge_points.evidence: The PM6:IDF-IC device after thermal annealing at 130 °C showed an increased PCE of 7.80%... in which the increases are mainly from the large enhancement on Jsc and FF.
